title: MZ Trying to figure out how to resize and move windows with VisuStella ElementStatusCore

posts.author: james5272
posts.body:
I am preparing to contact VisuStella support with a couple issues I can't find solutions for, if this is another one of them I will add it to the list when I reach out to them.
Basically see screenshot.  As you can see, the text for "General" overlaps with the border of that window.  I had the same issue with their Bestiary plugin (due to my font size), but that had obvious entries for window sizes and position, so I could make changes as needed.  With ElementStatusCore I don't see any such options.
I would need to make this window go lower so submenu text fits in the window properly, then move the bottom window down by the same amount.

posts.author: Magenta-Fantasies
posts.body: I remember I used to have that exact same problem and now I don't. I didn't actively try to correct it; it just went away on its own. This leads me to think that updating RPG Maker MZ's corescript solved the issue. I didn't even have to update the VisuStella plugins. Have you tried updating RPG Maker MZ to the latest version?

posts.author: james5272
posts.body:
I've been on 1.80 cuz 1.81 has menu flicker for me (not in game but in the maker).  But I just updated to test then ran a playtest, and I still have the issue.
VisuStella already got back to me and said it isn't something they're going to fix, that the problem is my font size.  Like wtf?  Then make a window size and position option like the Bestiary plugin has...
I'm offering to tip them if they add this feature, I know it's a free plugin... but if I have to pay for it to be better I'm happy to.
